offering_description.value: Centuri builds and maintains electric, natural gas, distributed energy, and underground infrastructure for utilities, energy providers, municipalities, and industrial operators. It delivers construction and modernization projects and restores networks after storms.

quotes.quote: Centuri is a North American leader in utility construction, partnering with regulated utilities, energy providers, municipalities, and industrial operators to build and maintain the infrastructure and utilities that keep power, gas, and data flowing 24/7. Our purpose is simple yet ambitious: Connecting People to Power. We do so safely, reliably, and with an eye on the next generation of energy solutions.
Our services span electric transmission and distribution, natural gas pipelines, RNG and BESS facilities, fiber and water networks, wind and solar, and complete emergency restoration.

primary_services.value: Electric grid and substation construction and maintenance; gas pipeline construction and rehabilitation; renewable energy, storage and data center construction; underground fiber and water network construction; emergency response and storm restoration

quotes.quote: Our services span electric transmission and distribution, natural gas pipelines, RNG and BESS facilities, fiber and water networks, wind and solar, and complete emergency restoration.

We replace aging assets while improving reliability, capacity, and system control by implementing modernization projects such as gas pipe replacement, cathodic protection upgrades, compressor and regulator station overhauls, as well as electric grid hardening projects, including transmission line upgrades, hardened distribution feeder rebuilds, and power substation upgrades. Our industrial and utility-scale energy transition projects include BESS installations, data centers, and RNG plant construction. Among utility infrastructure construction companies, our value is end-to-end execution, including engineering and design support, materials management, self-performed construction, testing, and commissioning.

Our purpose is simple yet ambitious: Connecting People to Power. We do so safely, reliably, and with an eye on the next generation of energy solutions.

“Investments in the power grid are the backbone of our nation’s economy,” notes Maria Robinson, former Director of the U.S. DOE Grid Deployment Office (GDO, 2024). Regulated utilities, pipeline operators, and clean energy developers must deliver uninterrupted service during every load spike and weather event. Centuri is the partner that turns that mandate into measurable reliability. From 500 kV transmission spans engineered to ride out 140-mph winds to gas mains directionally drilled beneath dense urban corridors, we bridge the last-mile gap so your network delivers.

revenue_model.value: project or contract: Infrastructure engineering, construction, repairs, restoration, and ongoing operations and maintenance

quotes.quote: Everything begins with a collaborative scoping conversation. During the Request for Proposal (RFP) or early planning phase, we review technical requirements, safety and environmental regulations, and any permits up front, drawing on our pre-construction services—engineering, project management, right-of-way acquisition, and materials planning—to set a clear execution path. A dedicated project team is assigned and mobilized once the scope, schedule, and budget are aligned.

Delivery isn’t where our commitment ends. Post-construction services include system relights, repairs, quality inspections, comprehensive as-built drawings, landscaping or hard-surface restoration, and even long-term Operations & Maintenance (O&M) support and electronic record-keeping. This ensures the asset performs safely and efficiently for years to come.

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada, with emergency response coverage across 46 states and six provinces

quotes.quote: Centuri (SEN-chur-ee) is a strategic infrastructure services company that partners with regulated utilities and energy providers to help build and maintain the energy network that powers millions of homes and businesses across the United States and Canada.

Extreme weather is the new normal, and utilities and municipalities need partners who can mobilize quickly. Centuri’s emergency response maintains real-time visibility of crews and equipment across 46 states and 6 Canadian provinces, allowing deployment within hours. We can immediately mobilize specialized crews and equipment to integrate rapid assessment with complete storm restoration. Centuri has participated in multiple storm response efforts, such as Hurricane Helene, which is a testament to our fast response ethos.

Centuri is a North American leader in utility construction, partnering with regulated utilities, energy providers, municipalities, and industrial operators to build and maintain the infrastructure and utilities that keep power, gas, and data flowing 24/7.
